bio: John Francis Connole was born at Elmira, NY, on 9 Mar 1853 and died 14 Mar 1923. He was 'educated in the public schools of Luzerne county' and briefly managed his father's Plymouth restaurant after 1878. On 19 Dec 1878 he married Mary E. Keating, daughter of Mrs. Mary (Russell) Keating (b. Co. Clare 1840), a widow who ran a hotel in Larksville from 1867, owned it and the next-door block, and whom Bradsby called 'a shrewd business woman'; the Russells had stopped at Wellsburg, NY (near Elmira) before Plymouth (1855) - the same Elmira-to-Plymouth route. His obituary names his mother 'Mary (Dwyer)' and stepmother 'Ann (Boner) Connole'. Father of Dr. Joseph V. Connole.
sources: Bradsby 1893, John F. Connole sketch p.~795 and Keating sketch p.~1049-1050: https://archive.org/details/historyofluzerne00brad
